question: Does reducing waypoint-guidance bandwidth remove the calm landing limit cycle without spoiling windy approaches?
selection_reason: Shortest tested period that removes the large calm oscillation; selected before wind/stress outcomes.
metrics_window: 20 simulated seconds before first active PGFL; truth attitude and heading rate, commanded turn rate and brake activity, plus ground-crossing miss/sink
scope: Parameter-only native SITL experiment. No firmware or published defaults changed. Not an independent Monte Carlo validation.
